title: question_libraries collection document
description: A named question bank owned by one user. Items live in question_library_items and reference the question entity (not a version), so a bank always shows the latest version. Semantic invariants (checked by the service): name is unique per owner; visibility private means owner-only, public means any signed-in user may browse and pick questions from it; only the owner may rename, change visibility or delete it.

owner_id.description: Owner; only the owner may modify the bank.

visibility.description: private is owner-only; public may be browsed by any signed-in user.
